steps.en: Install the CLI on the Mac
steps.zh: 在 Mac 上安装 CLI

steps.en: Attach to the booted device and open the host-HID path iOS 26 accepts
steps.zh: 挂上已启动的设备，打开 iOS 26 接受的宿主机 HID 通路

steps.en: Send a tap in device points
steps.zh: 用设备点坐标发一次点击

steps.en: Route the touch through the 9-arg digitizer path so the app's real handlers fire
steps.zh: 把触摸走 9 参数 digitizer 通路，让 app 真正的处理器被触发
抓一张 App Store 尺寸的截图

value.en: No human at Simulator.app and no broken 5-arg HID tool — one CLI drives input, capture and streaming headlessly.
value.zh: 不再需要人守着 Simulator.app，也不再依赖坏掉的 HID 工具——一个 CLI 无头完成输入与投屏。
